_comment: FAMS Vue Agents configuration. Edit in git, then re-run deploy/install.sh. Read by scripts/devops.mjs.

git._comment: Tecmo branching model: master = production, development = integration (everything awaiting the next production build). Work branches are made from development. Agents may only create/push their OWN branches: agents_features/<issue>-<slug> or agents_bugfixes/<mon><yyyy>/<issue>-<slug> (mon = jan feb mar apr may jun jul aug sept oct nov dec, like the team's bugfixes/sept2024). PRs go into development only. A write target may set its own base_branch (e.g. development-agent): agents then branch from it and open PRs only into it.

read_repos._comment: Repos the agents may clone and READ only (study). Nothing in them may be changed. Fams24 = legacy FAMS-UI (Vue 2) + FAMS-API.

write_targets._comment: The ONLY places the agents may change code: added by Hennie per project ({project, repo, paths:["folder/"] or ["./"] for the whole repo, base_branch (optional, default git.base_branch), agents_merge (optional: true = the Lead may complete PRs into base_branch), note}). Branch/commit/push/PR are refused everywhere else.

list.note: FAMS Vue 3 portal (2027). Agents work only in FAMS-UI/. They branch from development-agent; the Lead completes their PRs into development-agent (pr-complete) after Tester PASS + Reviewer APPROVE. Never development (humans' component experiments) or master.
